column1: # condition_facets.tsv — controlled vocabulary of the facets that make up `condition_context`
# (PLAN.md C.5), the entity that "decides whether cross-study integration is possible at all."
# One row per facet field (not per facet group), so a loader can validate a parsed condition
# Binding rules carried from PLAN.md C.5 / docs/reference/CONVENTIONS.md "Conditions":
#   * `condition_context` is immutable and deduplicated by `context_hash` over its RECORDED
#   * "Every facet has an as_reported shadow field" — the `as_reported_shadow` column below is
#     'true' for every facet without exception; a facet that is enum/parsed (Zone H) always keeps
#     the string the paper used (Zone R) beside it.
#   * NULL = never recorded by the source; 'NA' = recorded as genuinely not applicable (e.g. `ph`
#     for an aeration_class that makes pH moot is still NULL unless the paper explicitly says "not
#     controlled" style NA — most facets will be NULL, not NA, when a paper is silent); 'unknown'
#     = recorded but not resolvable to one of `allowed_values`. This file constrains what
#     `allowed_values` a Zone H parse may resolve an enum facet to; it does not force a value.
#   facet_group        the PLAN.md C.5 table's row grouping (Carbon, Nitrogen & medium, Oxygen,
#                      Mode, Physical, Scale, Inoculum, Stressor, Sampling)
#   field              the field name, dotted for a struct member (e.g. stressor.compound)
#   type               enum | numeric | free_text | bool | struct | reference — this curator's
#                      classification of the field, not a PLAN.md-stated type annotation
#   allowed_values     pipe-separated closed values for an enum field, or 'NA' for a non-enum
#                      field, or 'unknown' where PLAN.md names the field but not its value set
#   unit_hint          expected unit for a numeric field, or 'NA'
# Evidence-honesty pass (this revision, following the compartments.tsv D1 rewrite): every row
# below that was 'high' solely on the strength of citing another fermdb file (PLAN.md,
# docs/reference/CONVENTIONS.md, a source module, or another vocabulary TSV) has been changed to
# 'unverified' -- citing an internal document is citing memory with an extra hop, not an
# independent check. A row stays 'high' only when its evidence names something actually checked
# outside the repo in this session (e.g. a ChEBI lookup via web search). The confidence vocabulary
# is closed and has four values everywhere ('unverified', 'low', 'medium', 'high'; D2);
# 'unverified' means asserted but never checked against a source, distinct from 'low' (checked,
# storage_location (new column, this revision): whether a loader must write this facet's parsed
# value as a first-class column on `condition_context`, or as a (context_id, facet) row in the
# differently here would write the same facet to two different places and silently break
# `context_hash` dedup (identical conditions would stop sharing one row). Derived directly from
# this file against it), not from PLAN.md or memory, so this column's correctness does not depend
# on the confidence rating in the row it sits in. Six first-class facets (vessel_type,
# working_volume_l, dilution_rate, time_h, scale_class, growth_phase) have their *parsed* value as
# a first-class column but their `_as_reported` shadow (when the source's wording matters) still
# lives in `condition_context_facet`, per schema.sql's comment on `condition_context`; this column
# reports where the value itself lives, not the shadow.
